subject: maths
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 5 days. B alone can do the same work in 55 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B can complete work in 5 days

B alone can complete work in 55 days

A has to complete double work

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 5 and 55 = 55

⇒ Total work = 55 units

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B) = 55 ÷ 5 = 11 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 55 ÷ 55 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Efficiency of A = 11 − 1 = 10 units/day

⇒ Double work = 2 × 55 = 110 units

⇒ Time taken by A = 110 ÷ 10 = 11 days

**∴ The correct answer is 11 days.**
